title: 第4章 监狱生活(一)

三天后，唐峰三人被大张旗鼓的送往了地处东北某地的监狱，这个监狱分内外两层，内层关押的都是一些重犯，一般杀一两个人的杀人犯连这里的门都没资格进。

同时，全国各大报社，电视台同时报道一条新闻：“中国某部队高级军官唐峰，关智勇，许强三人涉嫌酒后杀害5名日本商人被判终身监禁”

报道上说的没错，我们三个是杀了5个RB人，只不过这几个RB杂碎都是间谍，反正要找个借口进监狱，不如在最后为国做些贡献。

当押送三人的军车驶进监狱那一刻唐峰感觉这个世界充满了未知，谁能想到几天前还是大家口中的英雄此刻却以锒铛入狱？不过这并没有影响到他的好心情，此刻的他对未来的黑道生活充满了向往。

“95441，95442，95443，从今天开始你们就住在这里，有什么事可以叫我，记住在牢房里不准惹事。”年轻的狱警说完后便转身关上门走了出去。

见狱警走了，原本安静的犯人顿时喧哗起来。其中一个满身横肉，身上还纹了条下山虎的恶汉走上前拍了拍唐峰的肩膀道：“小子，犯的啥事？”

唐峰环顾了一圈牢房，这个牢房面积挺大，大概有50平米左右，两边摆满了床铺，粗略扫了一眼有20张，也就是这个宿舍里住了40人。

观察完环境，唐峰将目光锁定在眼前这个恶汉身上，5秒后冷声道：“杀人。”

说罢三人走到自己的床铺边，自顾自的闭目养神。

恶汉被下了面子，心中十分不爽，怎么说他也是这间牢房的“老大”，被这么个“新人”下了面子这叫他以后怎么混？朝周围的犯人打了个眼色，恶汉走到唐峰的床边将一只脚踩在床铺上，用手支着下巴，而那些恶汉的手下也慢慢将三人的床铺包围起来。只有3个鼻青脸肿的瘦弱青年依旧蹲在角落里。

“小子，你他妈的以为你是谁啊？操你个妈的，这里老子才是老大，别在我面前给我装逼，你以为自己是个杀人犯就很牛逼了是不？老子告诉你，这牢房里个个都是杀人犯，瞧见那边蹲着的那几个没？他们刚开始和你们一样，但现在是啥结果？每天让老子当靶子练。”说完还指了指角落里的三个青年，而那三个青年见恶汉朝他们看来，吓的缩了缩身子，显然是被打怕了。

唐峰怕吗？当然不，只见唐峰皱了皱眉头轻声道：“给你三秒钟拿开你的脚，一，二，三”声音刚落一拳已经轰在恶汉那有些吓人的脸上。

“啊”被唐峰打中的恶汉双手捂住脸哀号着，有些发黑的血水从指缝留了出来，周围的人被这一拳吓傻了，这恶汉可是监狱里的一霸，不但实力强横，和监狱里很多狱警也都是称兄道弟，打死他们也想不到平时耀武扬威的恶汉竟然被一个看似普通的人一拳打倒在地。

许强和关智勇见唐峰动了手，连忙站起身来恶狠狠的看着眼前的犯人们，仿佛在他们眼中这些被经常曾今在外面呼风唤雨的人物都如羔羊一般。

说来这恶汉也不简单，硬挨了唐峰一拳而且还是在最脆弱的地方竟然还能挣扎着站起来，虽说唐峰只用了七分力，可这也不是一般人能抵挡的住的，要是一般人别说是站起来了，估计就直接见上帝了。

“操你妈个把子的，敢偷袭老子，你们给我上，凑死这几个小B样的，妈个B的，老子今天搞死你们。”说完后带头冲向三人。

十分钟后，战斗停止了，而还能站着的却只有唐峰三人，看着地上横七竖八的躺着的三十多个壮汉，唐峰也有些哑然，总体来说这些人都不错，其中好几个甚至比一般的特种兵还要厉害几分，只是他们运气不好，遇见的是唐峰三人。

地上的人看着唐峰三人眼中都流露出恐惧的神情，这还是人吗？他们自己的实力如何他们十分清楚，竟然被三个人这么轻易的就摆平了。

从这天开始，唐峰三人理所当然的成为了这个牢房的老大，也从这些人身上学到了不少东西，比如最简单的抽烟、喝酒、说粗话。原本监狱里是不准喝酒的，可那恶汉却实有些本事，竟然每隔2天就能搞到一，两瓶酒，虽然只是普通的二锅头却也让这些重犯们高兴不已，要知道这些个人进来前那个不是每日无酒不欢的主。

当然，唐峰也对这些人有了一定的了解，令他惊讶的是这三十多个人竟然有一大半进来前是黑社会份子，而且似乎地位还不低，其中唐峰最为在意的就是那个恶汉和那几个身手不错的家伙，而那三个每日被欺负的小青年自从唐峰当上老大后在也没有没欺负过，搞的三个小伙子现在对唐峰比亲爹还亲。

恶汉名叫王胜，以前在外面混的时候有个外号叫“虎王”，还是个不小的帮派老大，因为自己兄弟被杀女人被另一个帮派老大强奸，一口气屠杀三十多人，本来是因该被判死刑的，可这家伙家底不少，在“捐献”了所有家底后被改判了无期。对这个人唐峰很欣赏，虽然刚来时发生了些不愉快，但几天的相处下来唐峰发现这个人并没有想象中的那么坏，试问一个如此重情重义的人在坏又能坏到那去呢？这一点唐峰觉得和自己很像，虽然自己没经历过这样的事，但如果这样的事发生在自己身上，他相信他也会像王胜一样。虽然说话、办事比较粗俗，但他是黑社会，黑社会就因该是这样。

其他的人中有4个竟然曾今也是特种兵，分别是“炮手”，“铁人”，“钢牙”，“野狼”。这四人当年从特种部队退役后国家给的那点钱早早便花光，四人除了打架什么都不会，无奈之下只得去给人当保镖，在一次雇主被人袭击时，四人为了保护雇主而杀了8个人，因他们是防卫过当被判了5年，明年就可以出去了。或许因为曾今是同行吧，唐峰三人对这四人都很欣赏，而唐峰却心中早有打算，等这四人出去后他就要将这四人收为己用。

“老虎，我觉得不对啊，按理说你个人实力是比炮手他们强，但是要是他们四个打你一个你没可能会赢啊，怎么还能让他们当你的小弟呢？”许强问出了心中存在许久的疑问。

“呵，呵呵，说来还有点不好意思，他们四个来的时候我都已经在里面蹲了3年了，这的人早就被我收复了，他们四个刚来时和你们的情况差不多，老子不是他们四的对手，可他们也没你们这么变态啊，我让小弟们一哄而上就把他们给打趴下了。”老虎有些不好意思的挠了挠头说。

“哈哈，操，你这个老小子就会人多欺负人少，妈的，还他妈曾今当过老大呢，就着德性？你那些小弟们也服？”许强的改造最为成功，短短几天已经颇具匪气，现在十足的像个黑社会份子。

“操蛋，你说啥呢？老子是黑社会，黑社会不用装B，打的赢老子就打，打不赢老子就群起而攻之，只要能赢那就是行了。”老虎似乎还有些得意的说道。

Three days later, Tang Feng and the other three were sent to a prison somewhere in the Northeast with great fanfare. This prison was divided into two floors: an inner one and an inner one. The inner one held some serious criminals. Generally, murderers who killed one or two people were not even qualified to enter the door here.

At the same time, major newspapers and TV stations across the country reported a news: "Senior officers of a certain Chinese army, Tang Feng, Guan Zhiyong, and Xu Qiang, were sentenced to life imprisonment for allegedly murdering five Japanese businessmen while drunk."

The report is correct, the three of us killed 5 RBs, but these RBs are all spies. We have to find an excuse to go to jail anyway, so why not make some contribution to the country in the end.

When the military vehicle escorting the three people drove into the prison, Tang Feng felt that the world was full of unknowns. Who would have thought that the hero everyone said a few days ago would now be imprisoned?However, this did not affect his good mood. At this moment, he was full of yearning for the future underworld life.

"95441, 95442, 95443, you will live here from today on. If you need anything, you can call me. Remember, you are not allowed to cause trouble in the cell." After the young prison guard finished speaking, he turned around and closed the door and walked out.

Seeing the prison guards leaving, the originally quiet prisoners suddenly became noisy.One of the evil men, who was covered in flesh and had a mountain tiger tattooed on his body, stepped forward and patted Tang Feng on the shoulder and said, "Boy, what did you do?"

Tang Feng looked around the cell. This cell was quite large, about 50 square meters, with beds on both sides. At a glance, there were 20 beds, which meant that there were 40 people living in this dormitory.

After observing the environment, Tang Feng locked his eyes on the villain in front of him and said coldly after 5 seconds: "Kill."

After that, the three of them walked to their beds and closed their eyes to rest.

The evil man was disgraced and felt very unhappy. After all, he was also the "boss" of this cell, so how could he survive in the future when he was disgraced by such a "newcomer"?With a wink at the prisoners around him, the villain walked to Tang Feng's bed, put one foot on the bed, and supported his chin with his hand, while the villain's men slowly surrounded the three people's beds.Only three thin young men with bruises and swollen faces were still squatting in the corner.

"Boy, who the hell do you think you are? Fuck you, I'm the boss here, don't show off in front of me, you think you're awesome just because you're a murderer, don't you? I'm telling you, everyone in this cell is a murderer. Look at the squatting person over there.Are there any of them?They were just like you at the beginning, but what happened now?I was used as a target for practice every day." After saying that, he pointed at the three young men in the corner, and when the three young men saw the evil man looking at them, they shrank back, obviously afraid of being beaten.

Is Tang Feng afraid?Of course not, Tang Feng frowned and said softly: "I'll give you three seconds to take your feet off, one, two, three." As soon as the voice landed, a punch hit the villain's somewhat scary face.

"Ah" the villain who was hit by Tang Feng covered his face with both hands and wailed. Some black blood remained from his fingers. The people around him were frightened by the punch. This villain was a tyrant in the prison. Not only was he powerful, but he was also brothers with many guards in the prison. Even if they were beaten to death, they would never have imagined that the usually arrogant villain would be knocked to the ground by a seemingly ordinary person.

When Xu Qiang and Guan Zhiyong saw that Tang Feng had moved his hands, they quickly stood up and looked at the prisoners in front of them fiercely, as if in their eyes these people who were often called the shots were like lambs.

Speaking of which, this evil guy is not an easy man. He took a punch from Tang Feng and still struggled to stand up in the most vulnerable place. Although Tang Feng only used 70% of his strength, it was not something that ordinary people could withstand. If ordinary people could not stand up, they would probably meet God directly.

"Fuck you, you dare to sneak up on me, come on and kill these little bastards. Damn you, I will kill you today." After saying that, he took the lead and rushed towards the three of them.

Ten minutes later, the fighting stopped, but only Tang Feng and the others were still standing. Looking at the more than 30 strong men lying on the ground, Tang Feng was a little dumbfounded. Generally speaking, these people were good, and several of them were even better than ordinary special forces. It was just that they were unlucky, and they met Tang Feng and the others.

The people on the ground looked at Tang Feng and the three of them with expressions of fear in their eyes. Are these still human beings?They knew very well how strong they were, yet they were defeated so easily by three people.

From that day on, Tang Feng and the other three naturally became the bosses of this cell, and they also learned a lot from these people, such as the simplest things like smoking, drinking, and swearing.Originally, drinking was not allowed in the prison, but the villain was actually quite capable. He was able to get one or two bottles of wine every two days. Even though it was just an ordinary Erguotou, it made these felons very happy. You must know that the person before these people came in was not someone who drank and had fun every day.

Of course, Tang Feng also had a certain understanding of these people. What surprised him was that more than half of the thirty or so people were gangsters before they came in, and their status seemed to be quite high. Among them, Tang Feng was most concerned about the villain and those guys with good skills. The three young men who were bullied every day had not been bullied since Tang Feng became the boss. The three young men were now closer to Tang Feng than their own father.

The villain's name is Wang Sheng. He used to be nicknamed "Tiger King" when he was outside. He was also a big gang boss. Because his brother was killed and a woman was raped by another gang boss, he massacred more than 30 people in one go. He was originally supposed to be sentenced to death, but this guy had a lot of money. After "donating" all his wealth, his sentence was commuted to life.He admired this person Tang Feng very much. Although he had some unpleasant experiences when he first came here, after getting along with him for a few days, Tang Feng found that this person was not as bad as he thought. How bad could a person who values ​​love and justice be so bad?Tang Feng felt that this was very similar to himself. Although he had never experienced such a thing, if such a thing happened to him, he believed that he would be like Wang Sheng.Although his words and actions are vulgar, he is a gangster, and that's how the gangsters should be.

Four of the other people were actually special forces, namely "Gunner", "Iron Man", "Steel Teeth" and "Wild Wolf".After these four people retired from the special forces, the little money they received from the country was spent early. The four of them knew nothing but fighting, so they had no choice but to work as bodyguards. When their employer was attacked, the four of them killed eight people to protect their employer. They were sentenced to five years for over-defense, and they can go out next year.Perhaps because Zeng Jin was in the same company, Tang Feng and the other two people all admired these four people, but Tang Feng had already planned in his heart that he would take these four people for his own use after they left.

"Tiger, I don't think it's right. It stands to reason that your personal strength is better than that of the gunners, but if four of them beat you, you won't win. How can you let them be your younger brothers?" Xu Qiang asked the question that had been in his mind for a long time.

"Haha, haha, I'm a little embarrassed to say it. I had been squatting there for three years when the four of them came. I had already captured the people here. The four of them were in the same situation as you when they first came. I am no match for the four of them, but they are not as perverted as you. I asked the younger brothers to rush up and beat them down." Tiger said, scratching his head in embarrassment.

"Haha, fuck, you are an old boy who knows how to bully others when there are more people. Damn it, you have been the boss before. Just for virtue? Do your younger brothers also obey?" Xu Qiang's transformation was the most successful. In just a few days, he became quite gangster, and now he looks like a gangster.

"Damn it, what are you talking about? I'm a gangster. There's no need to pretend to be a gangster. If you can win, I'll fight. If you can't, just attack in groups. As long as you can win, that's all." Tiger said with some pride.
